title: Make salesman commission evidence scoped bounded and currency-safe
description: Users opening the existing salesman commission report see only authorized approved order evidence, with explicit limits and honest unknowns. Require a non-null SalespersonDataScope service argument; update the existing endpoint to resolve identity/menu/fresh customer scope. Validate inclusive dates before any source reads, at most 366 days, include the whole end day via next-day exclusive bound and reject overflow. Filter approved nondeleted SalesOrders by customer scope before a stable Take(501), reject more than 500 without partial aggregates. Preserve explicit unassigned-salesman bucket as distinct from missing/deleted employee identity; employee lookup is one bounded nondeleted batch for scoped IDs, never an employee authority or broad directory. Aggregate by persisted salesman bucket and raw original Currency key, stable ordering; signed header TotalAmount only for supported currencies, invalid raw currencies remain distinct with amount null/counts. Stop reading SalesOrderDetails or current BaseProducts costs for this report. Historical comparable cost is absent: Profit, ProfitRate and CommissionAmount remain null with reasons even when parameter is zero; never derive payout from current cost or infer zero. Read at most two nondeleted SalesCommissionRate parameter records; exactly one invariant plain decimal 0..100 is a nullable current reference rate, including explicitly configured zero. Missing, duplicate, malformed, negative or excessive configuration is unknown with reason, never fallback zero, no parameter mutation. Add source/currency/profit/commission/rate labels. Existing page renders null as unknown, labels rate as current reference only and signed per-currency amounts; KPI never sums different currencies, counts and percentages or labels a payout as earned. Adapt only the report calls in existing AgencyServiceFeeAgreementTests to explicit scope while retaining their registration/void non-mutation assertions. Development only. Reuse existing sales-commission menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted SalesOrders and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; each endpoint rechecks identity, menu and fresh scope and validates the current request, failing closed without data/file on revocation, invalid input or source overflow. Salesman filters are order attributes and never expand customer scope. Current parameter rate is reference information, not a historical agreed rate, actual payout, customer agency fee or ledger entry. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Existing API and service enforce fresh menu/customer scope, approved-only date bounds and 500-order cap before bounded employee/parameter reads.

Salesman and raw-currency buckets preserve signed known order amounts and unknown historical profit/payout; bounded parameter parsing distinguishes explicit zero from invalid or missing reference rates.

Report table and KPI show per-currency evidence and unknowns without unsupported payout claims; focused authorization, bounds, evidence and adjacent-register non-mutation tests plus safe build/test pass.
